summary: Tested Area Riservata (5 tabs), Bilanci di salute, Famiglia e Consensi, profile menu, Trova Specialista availability with prefilled booking, public /medico/tiziana-foti availability, and GET /api/public/doctors/{slug}/availability. Backend: 9/9 new pytest pass (test_availability.py) and 27/27 regression pass (test_showcase.py, test_portal_docs.py). The response has the right shape; the default is at most 6 slots, sorted; limit is capped at 12; an invalid service falls back to the first service ('Prima visita'); the clinic filter works, and an unknown clinic returns []; an unknown slug returns 404; slots fall within 14 days; every public slot also appears in /api/portal/slots for Aurora. Note: the slug in the review request ('app-archive-zip') is not a doctor and correctly returns 404. I tested with tiziana-foti. Frontend (genitore.demo) passes end to end. The sidebar 'Area Riservata' link goes to /portale/documenti with the title 'Area Riservata'. All 5 tabs set ?tab= and aria-selected, and deep links work. Bilanci: docs-bilanci-next ('Bilancio di salute dei 5-6 anni'), the PrevisitCard button opens the checkpoint wizard, 2 docs-bilancio-visit rows show, the bilancio PDF downloads, and 5 checkpoints show. Famiglia: the Aurora card shows birth date and sex, doctor Foti, 7 consent rows (1 Attivo, 6 Revocato), the studio revocation note, signed docs with PDF buttons, the NetworkSharing block (share-need-two) and the AddChild form at the bottom. There is no revoke button. Visite still lists 3 visits and the Referto PDF downloads; Prescrizioni shows 2 rows; Ricevute shows the empty state. Profile menu: profile-documents reads 'Area Riservata · documenti e famiglia' and goes to /portale/documenti; profile-account reads 'Impostazioni account' and goes to /portale/impostazioni. Trova Specialista: the dialog shows showcase-availability, 4 services and a clinic select (Tutti/Centro/Provincia), and slots update when filters change. Choosing the 'Bilancio di salute' service, Studio Provincia and the 15:00 slot on 2026-10-22 closed the dialog and opened the booking dialog with Aurora, Dott.ssa Foti, Studio Provincia, Bilancio di salute, 2026-10-22 and 15:00 already selected; submit was enabled. I did not submit. availability-empty renders with mocked empty data. Public page (no login): 6 slots show, and clicking one goes to /portale/trova-specialista?medico=tiziana-foti; after login that URL is kept and the dialog opens. Mobile 390: no horizontal page overflow, and the tablist scrolls (902px of content in 358px). No page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, a deep link like ?tab=famiglia leaves the active tab off-screen (x=726 in a 390px viewport), so the user cannot see which tab is active. Fix: call scrollIntoView({inline:'nearest'}) on the active tab when tab changes.
docs-bilancio-pdf-* calls api.portalReport directly, without the DlBtn loading state or success/error toast (Visite uses DlBtn). An error would be an unhandled promise rejection.

integration_issues.issue: The chosen slot is dropped: the redirect only passes ?medico=, so after login the user sees the profile dialog and has to pick the slot again. Suggestion: also pass &slot=date|time|clinic|service and open RequestDialog with that preset.

issues: The consent list shows every historical version (7 rows, 6 revoked), and the signed docs list is just as long. Suggest showing the active consent first and collapsing revoked history ('Mostra storico').
Text is gender-neutral but awkward: 'Nato/a', 'Medici che lo seguono' (Aurora is female; sex is known, so the wording could adapt).
'Data desiderata' uses the browser's native date input rather than the shadcn Calendar.

action_items: (Low) Scroll the active tab into view in the mobile tablist when it is set from ?tab=
(Low) Use DlBtn (loading and toast) for the Bilanci Referto PDF button
(Optional) Keep the chosen slot through the public page to portal redirect
(Optional) Collapse revoked consent and document history in Famiglia
critical_code_review_comments: showcase.availability takes at most 3 slots per clinic per day (times[:3]). The 6 returned are sorted but are not strictly the 6 earliest free slots: 09:45 on the first day is skipped in favour of slots at the other clinic. This spreads slots across clinics, which is fine if intended, but the docstring should say so.
showcase.availability runs up to 15 days × N clinics sequential free_slots calls, each making 2 Mongo queries. It is unauthenticated, so consider light caching or rate limiting.
Availability.jsx shows the 'empty' message on fetch errors too, so a network error is presented as 'no availability'.
Availability service select shows only once a.services loads; when the doctor has a single clinic the clinic select is hidden by design (verified with mocked data).
seed_data_creation: None. No booking requests were submitted.
